scope: Read-only descriptive motion diagnostic; population audit not executed
input_cohort: All50 declared base-resolution reference jobs: development/reserved and calibration/primary/stress; failed jobs retained
precondition: All50 complete.json records must exist before any motion trajectories are read
metric: Exact consistent P1 volume-mass weighted proper Kabsch per postinitial frame; physicalCOM from mass row sums, covariance A.T@(M@B), coordinate RMS divisor3*totalmass
ratio: Deformation RMS divided by world displacement RMS, not a variance fraction
aggregation: Equal saved-frame weight within a case; equal completed-case weight within numeric summaries conditional on auditable trajectories, with failures retained in counts and undefined-ratio counts retained
limitations: No material-identifiability, calibrated-uncertainty or physical-truth inference; no cohort or metric changes to prediction benchmark
synthetic_validation: 4tests passed: rigid motion zero residual/physicalCOM; analytic affine stretch and mesh independence; world-frame invariance; reflection is not a proper rotation
execution_status: Prepared only; population audit awaits all50 completion records and independent review
protocol_binding: Runtime requires protocol SHA256 equals method-freeze.protocol_sha256
